### ===============================
### (A) Data preparation
### =============================== 
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)



# Load packages 
rm(list = ls())

library(survival)
library(MASS)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(performance)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Import analysis dataset
data_aGvHD24 <- read_xlsx(
  "C:/Users/Sarsangjang/Desktop/GVHD Project/Extra_files/Other_GVHD/New folder/imputed_data_MDS_r1.xlsx")

# Convert required columns to numeric
data_aGvHD24[1:28] <- lapply(
  data_aGvHD24[1:28],
  as.numeric
)


# Check percentage of missing values
missing_summary_aGvHD24 <- data_aGvHD24 %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ mean(is.na(.))
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Missing_proportion"
  ) %>%
  filter(Missing_proportion > 0)

missing_summary_aGvHD24
```

### ===============================
### (B) Stepwise variable Selection; Acute GVHD24
### =============================== 

```{r , results='markup',echo = FALSE}

# ============================================================
# 1. Define candidate clinical covariates
# ============================================================
# COX-PH assumptions checked befor variable selection including multicolinearity and proportional hazard assumption for final model.#


'
Patient age
Conditioning regimen
Donor age
WBC
HCT-CI score
Diagnosis to transplant (Month)
GvHD prophylaxis
Hypomethylating agents
IPSS-R score
Karnofsky score
Therapy related/Secondary MDS
Donor type
Donor/recipient CMV status
Donor/recipient sex match
Graft source
Number of Chemo treatments
'


covariates_aGvHD24 <- c(
  "age",
  "condint",
  "dnrage",
  "wbc1pr",
  "coorgscore_r",
  "indxtx_cat",
  "gvhprhrx_r",
  "hmapr_r",
  "ipssrpr_r",
  "kps_r",
  "mdstype_r",
  "donorgp",
  "drcmvpr",
  "drsex",
  "graftype",
  "nchemopr_r"
)




# ============================================================
# 2. complete-case dataset for all models
# ============================================================

model_variables_aGvHD24 <- c(
  "intxagvhd24",
  "agvhd24",
  covariates_aGvHD24
)

data_aGvHD24 <- data_aGvHD24 %>%
  dplyr::select(
    all_of(model_variables_aGvHD24)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    complete.cases(.)
  )

nrow(data_aGvHD24)

# ============================================================
# 3. Full cause-specific Cox model
# ============================================================

formula_full_aGvHD24 <- as.formula(
  paste(
    "Surv(intxagvhd24, agvhd24) ~",
    paste(
      covariates_aGvHD24,
      collapse = " + "
    )
  )
)

cox_full_aGvHD24 <- coxph(
  formula_full_aGvHD24,
  data = data_aGvHD24,
  x = TRUE
)

summary(cox_full_aGvHD24)

# ============================================================#

check_collinearity(
  cox_full_aGvHD24
)
# ============================================================#

ph_test_aGvHD24 <- cox.zph(
  cox_full_aGvHD24
)

ph_test_aGvHD24
plot(ph_test_aGvHD24)


# ============================================================
# 4) Full model: HR (95% CI) and P-value
# ============================================================

summary_full_aGvHD24 <- summary(
  cox_full_aGvHD24
)

results_full_aGvHD24 <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(
    summary_full_aGvHD24$coefficients
  ),

  `HR (95% CI)` = sprintf(
    "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
    summary_full_aGvHD24$conf.int[, "exp(coef)"],
    summary_full_aGvHD24$conf.int[, "lower .95"],
    summary_full_aGvHD24$conf.int[, "upper .95"]
  ),

  `P-value` = ifelse(
    summary_full_aGvHD24$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001,
    "<0.001",
    sprintf(
      "%.3f",
      summary_full_aGvHD24$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  ),

  row.names = NULL,
  check.names = FALSE
)

results_full_aGvHD24

# ============================================================
# 4. Final model
# ============================================================

cox_final_aGvHD24 <- stepAIC(
  cox_full_aGvHD24,
  direction = "both",
  trace = TRUE
)



variables_retained_aGvHD24 <- attr(
  terms(cox_final_aGvHD24),
  "term.labels"
)

variables_retained_aGvHD24



summary(
  cox_final_aGvHD24
)

AIC_final_aGvHD24 <- AIC(
  cox_final_aGvHD24
)

AIC_final_aGvHD24


# ============================================================
# 5. Final model HR, 95% CI, and P-values
# ============================================================

summary_final_aGvHD24 <- summary(
  cox_final_aGvHD24
)

results_final_aGvHD24 <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(
    summary_final_aGvHD24$coefficients
  ),

  `HR (95% CI)` = sprintf(
    "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
    summary_final_aGvHD24$conf.int[, "exp(coef)"],
    summary_final_aGvHD24$conf.int[, "lower .95"],
    summary_final_aGvHD24$conf.int[, "upper .95"]
  ),

  `P-value` = ifelse(
    summary_final_aGvHD24$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001,
    "<0.001",
    sprintf(
      "%.3f",
      summary_final_aGvHD24$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  ),

  row.names = NULL,
  check.names = FALSE
)

results_final_aGvHD24

# ============================================================
# 6. Overall P-value and AIC after dropping each retained term
# ============================================================

tests_retained_aGvHD24 <- drop1(
  cox_final_aGvHD24,
  test = "Chisq"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "Variable"
  )

tests_retained_aGvHD24


# ============================================================
# 7. Stepwise selection history
# ============================================================

selection_history_aGvHD24 <- as.data.frame(
  cox_final_aGvHD24$anova
)

selection_history_aGvHD24


# ============================================================
# 8. Reconstruct model at every step
# ============================================================

current_terms <- attr(
  terms(cox_full_aGvHD24),
  "term.labels"
)

models_stepwise_aGvHD24 <- list()

# Step 0: full model
models_stepwise_aGvHD24[[1]] <- cox_full_aGvHD24


if (nrow(selection_history_aGvHD24) > 1) {

  for (i in 2:nrow(selection_history_aGvHD24)) {

    action <- trimws(
      as.character(
        selection_history_aGvHD24$Step[i]
      )
    )

    # Variable removed
    if (
      !is.na(action) &&
      startsWith(action, "-")
    ) {

      removed_variable <- trimws(
        sub("^-", "", action)
      )

      current_terms <- setdiff(
        current_terms,
        removed_variable
      )
    }

    # Variable added
    if (
      !is.na(action) &&
      startsWith(action, "+")
    ) {

      added_variable <- trimws(
        sub("^\\+", "", action)
      )

      current_terms <- union(
        current_terms,
        added_variable
      )
    }

    formula_step_aGvHD24 <- as.formula(
      paste(
        "Surv(intxagvhd24, agvhd24) ~",
        paste(
          current_terms,
          collapse = " + "
        )
      )
    )

    models_stepwise_aGvHD24[[i]] <- coxph(
      formula_step_aGvHD24,
      data = data_aGvHD24,
      x = TRUE
    )
  }
}

# ============================================================
# 9. HR, CI, P-value, and AIC for ALL variables at EVERY step
# ============================================================

results_stepwise_aGvHD24 <- bind_rows(

  lapply(
    seq_along(models_stepwise_aGvHD24),
    function(i) {

      fit <- models_stepwise_aGvHD24[[i]]

      model_summary <- summary(fit)

      step_action <- if (i == 1) {
        "Full model"
      } else {
        as.character(
          selection_history_aGvHD24$Step[i]
        )
      }

      data.frame(
        Step = i - 1,

        Step_action = step_action,

        Variable = rownames(
          model_summary$coefficients
        ),

        HR = model_summary$conf.int[
          , "exp(coef)"
        ],

        Lower_95CI = model_summary$conf.int[
          , "lower .95"
        ],

        Upper_95CI = model_summary$conf.int[
          , "upper .95"
        ],

        P_value = model_summary$coefficients[
          , "Pr(>|z|)"
        ],

        AIC = AIC(fit),

        row.names = NULL
      )
    }
  )
) %>%

  mutate(
    `HR (95% CI)` = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
      HR,
      Lower_95CI,
      Upper_95CI
    ),

    `P-value` = ifelse(
      P_value < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      sprintf("%.3f", P_value)
    ),

    AIC = round(
      AIC,
      2
    )
  )

results_stepwise_aGvHD24


# Save Results
write.xlsx(
  list(
    "Full model" = results_full_aGvHD24,
    "Final model" = results_final_aGvHD24,
    "Selection history" = selection_history_aGvHD24,
    "All selection steps" = results_stepwise_aGvHD24
  ),
  file = "aGvHD24_variable_selection_results.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```
